name: AI Software Engineering Factory - Configurable AI Gateway

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value: You are an assistant inside an AI software engineering factory. Follow the requested task, be precise, and return only claims supported by your reasoning or available evidence.

nodes.name: AI Provider Configuration
nodes.notes: Edit baseUrl and model here. Use a base URL ending in /v1 (for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or https://api.example.com/v1). The workflow appends /chat/completions. Store the API key in the HTTP Header Auth credential, not in this node.

nodes.name: Validate Request and Provider
nodes.notes: Validates required inputs and normalizes the provider base URL. This is a basic configuration guard, not a complete SSRF/network security boundary.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }], temperature: $json.temperature, max_tokens: $json.maxTokens, stream: false }) }}

nodes.name: Call OpenAI-Compatible API
nodes.notes: Create an n8n Header Auth credential with header name Authorization and value Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Attach it to this node. Some providers require extra headers or use different endpoints; configure those here.
